verdict.rationale: Consensus is built as a scholarly search engine. It searches over 200 million academic papers rather than the open web, analyzes full text including paywalled publisher papers, and can filter to peer-reviewed work only. It also offers study-type, journal and discipline filters, citation-graph crawling and DOI lookup, and a Medical Mode limited to top journals and clinical guidelines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of corpus coverage and retrieval quality (the evidence is all vendor-authored, including the benchmark claim).
